personality_one_liner: A cozy, gamified virtual garden where real-life focus and goals nourish cutesy digital plants.

spacing.rule: Generous tactile spacing. Chunky cards with ample padding. Elements feel touchable, soft, and bouncy.

do's: Overlays on plant stage hero cards

screens.name: Garden
screens.purpose: Showcase the current growing plant and the user's garden collection with an XP progress bar.

states.loading: Centered bouncing sprout icon or spinner
states.empty: Illustration of an empty pot with 'Plant your first seed by setting a goal!' and a primary CTA 'Plant Seed'
states.error: Message 'Oh no, the garden is cloudy' with a retry button

screens.layout: Top: Fixed header with current level and XP bar. Center: A large, chunky hero card with glassmorphism overlay showcasing the current plant stage image (using hero_succulent or sprout_stage). Below: Horizontal scroll of 'My Garden' showing previous fully-grown plants as smaller cards. Bottom: Sticky primary CTA 'Water Plant' (navigates to Goals) above the bottom tab bar.

screens.name: Timer
screens.purpose: Pomodoro-style focus timer that feeds the plant.
screens.layout: Upper half: Large chunky circular timer using brandSecondary (green) for progress. Center of Timer: Cute sleeping or waiting plant image. Lower half: Session duration slider with large pill thumb. Bottom: Sticky 'Start Focusing' pill button.

screens.name: Goals
screens.purpose: Task checklist where completions earn XP and water for the plant.

states.loading: Skeleton list items with rounded pill shapes
states.empty: Illustration of an empty garden with 'No tasks today! Rest or add a new goal.' and an 'Add Goal' CTA
states.error: Error fetching tasks with a retry button

screens.layout: List of 'Today's Tasks'. Each row is a chunky surfaceSecondary card with a large left-aligned checkbox (pill shape). Top right: Filter/Sort icons. Floating Action Button (FAB) at bottom right for adding tasks.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: User stats, streak tracking, Google login, and unlocked badges.

states.empty: Prompt to 'Sign in with Google to save your garden'
states.error: Failed to load profile, retry button

screens.layout: Top: Profile header with Google avatar and Name. Middle: A 2-column grid of stats ('Current Streak', 'Total Focus Time') using surfaceSecondary cards. Bottom: A grid of unlocked colorful badges/achievements.

hero_succulent.alt: Cute potted succulent with a pink base representing a fully grown plant

sprout_stage.alt: Small green sprout emerging from soil representing an early plant stage

empty_garden.alt: Empty garden pot with whimsical signs waiting for a seed

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Tactile/Playful (Personality 4) rules: chunky cards, rounded pill shapes (radius lg to pill), and a soft, friendly aesthetic.
Use Phosphor icons with filled variants for active states and outlined for inactive.
Use Fredoka (Display) and Nunito (Body). Ensure heading weights are capped at 500 max.
Ensure the Pomodoro Timer screen uses a large, touchable circular layout, avoiding thin, clinical lines. Make it feel bouncy and gamified.
Do NOT use any shades of indigo, violet, purple, navy, or sky blue. The color palette centers around warm creams, sunshine yellow (brandPrimary), and emerald green (brandSecondary).
Implement spring animations (overshoot) for button presses (scale 0.93) to reinforce the tactile, gamified feel.
Whenever displaying plant imagery with text overlaid, enforce the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (top to bottom fade) to guarantee text contrast.
The Goals screen should use chunky list rows with oversized tap targets (min 56pt) for checkboxes.
Wire haptics to all major interactions using the provided haptics block map.
Avoid dense data grids; prioritize whitespace and generous margins (md/lg).
